parse_string.brief: Tries to parse the given string into an action.
parse_string.md:
Tries to parse the given string into an action.

On success, the parsed action is returned. When parsing
failed, `NULL` is returned.

The accepted strings are:

- `nothing`, for `GtkNothingAction`
- `activate`, for `GtkActivateAction`
- `mnemonic-activate`, for `GtkMnemonicAction`
- `action(NAME)`, for a `GtkNamedAction` for the action named `NAME`
- `signal(NAME)`, for a `GtkSignalAction` for the signal `NAME`

doc.brief: Encodes an action that can be triggered by a keyboard shortcut.
doc.md:
Encodes an action that can be triggered by a keyboard shortcut.

`GtkShortcutActions` contain functions that allow easy presentation
to end users as well as being printed for debugging.

All `GtkShortcutActions` are immutable, you can only specify their
properties during construction. If you want to change a action, you
have to replace it with a new one. If you need to pass arguments to
an action, these are specified by the higher-level `GtkShortcut` object.

To activate a `GtkShortcutAction` manually, [`ShortcutAction.activate()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ShortcutAction#method:activate)
can be called.

GTK provides various actions:

 - [`MnemonicAction`](xref:gtk:Gtk.MnemonicAction): a shortcut action that calls
   gtk_widget_mnemonic_activate()
 - [`CallbackAction`](xref:gtk:Gtk.CallbackAction): a shortcut action that invokes
   a given callback
 - [`SignalAction`](xref:gtk:Gtk.SignalAction): a shortcut action that emits a
   given signal
 - [`ActivateAction`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ActivateAction): a shortcut action that calls
   gtk_widget_activate()
 - [`NamedAction`](xref:gtk:Gtk.NamedAction): a shortcut action that calls
   gtk_widget_activate_action()
 - [`NothingAction`](xref:gtk:Gtk.NothingAction): a shortcut action that does nothing

activate.brief: Activates the action on the `widget` with the given `args`.
activate.md:
Activates the action on the `widget` with the given `args`.

Note that some actions ignore the passed in `flags`, `widget` or `args`.

Activation of an action can fail for various reasons. If the action
is not supported by the `widget`, if the `args` don't match the action
or if the activation otherwise had no effect, `FALSE` will be returned.

print.brief: Prints the given action into a string for the developer.
print.md:
Prints the given action into a string for the developer.

This is meant for debugging and logging.

The form of the representation may change at any time and is
not guaranteed to stay identical.

to_string.brief: Prints the given action into a human-readable string.
to_string.md:
Prints the given action into a human-readable string.

This is a small wrapper around [`ShortcutAction.print()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ShortcutAction#method:print)
to help when debugging.
